description: This file defines the UploadStream class, a stream wrapper handler for managing file uploads within the SuiteCRM environment. It includes methods for stream registration, stream operations, directory management, and security checks related to the Suhosin PHP extension.

classes.name: UploadStream
classes.description: A stream wrapper class for handling upload streams, providing file system access via custom stream protocols, directory management, and security features to ensure safe file uploads.

methods.name: getSuhosinStatus
methods.description: Checks Suhosin extension restrictions to determine if the upload stream protocol is allowed.

methods.name: getDir
methods.description: Returns the upload directory path, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: writable
methods.description: Verifies if the upload directory is writable.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the UploadStream as a PHP stream wrapper.

methods.name: path
methods.description: Converts a stream URL to its corresponding filesystem path, validating the path for security.

methods.name: ensureDir
methods.description: Ensures that the directory for a given upload path exists, creating it if not.

methods.name: move_uploaded_file
methods.description: Moves an uploaded file to a specified stream path.
